corrections.old_text: ኩክሙ ለ፲ወ፪ቱ ።⟫ ማቴ ፲ ፩ ፤ ፮
corrections.corrected_text: ኩክሙ ለ፲ወ፪ቱ ።⟫ ማቴ ፲ ፩ ፤ ፬
corrections.reason: The cross-reference for the choosing of the twelve apostles is Matthew 10:1-4 (ማቴ ፲ ፩ ፤ ፬), and the numeral ፬ is clearly visible on the page.

corrections.old_text: ማር ፫ ፳፱ ሉቃ ፬ ፳
corrections.corrected_text: ማር ፫ ፲፬ ሉቃ ፮ ፲፫
corrections.visual_confusable_pair: ፳፱ -> ፲፬, ፬ ፳ -> ፮ ፲፫
corrections.reason: The canonical Gospel parallels for choosing the twelve are Mark 3:14 (ማር ፫ ፲፬) and Luke 6:13 (ሉቃ ፮ ፲፫), matching the printed Ethiopic numerals.
Translating Ge'ez 'እምኔክሙ' (from among you), the printed Amharic word begins with 'ከ' (ከናንተ), not 'በ'.
Completing 'የኀሥ↵ዎ' (they sought Him) from line 9; the glyph at the start of line 10 is clearly 'ዎ' with its top loop and single stem, not 'ሠ'.
Visual inspection and Amharic grammar confirm the plural verb 'ይሻሉና' (for they seek [to kill him]), where 'ሉ' was misread as 'ታል'.
Completing 'ትግ↵ሬ' from line 27; the 5th-order ring at the bottom of 'ሬ' is visible.
In the Andemta explanation of 'አርዳኢከኒ' (your disciples), the text reads 'ከጉባዔው ከዋለ ደቀ መዝሙር ማለት ልማድ ነው' (if one spends time in the assembly, it is customary to call him a disciple).
